rds-info1: This guide applies to RDS CAL licenses (per user or per device) for Windows Server 2008 R2 – 2025. The CAL version must be the same as or newer than the Windows Server version running Remote Desktop Services.
rds-b1-pas1: 1. Make sure the server has the Remote Desktop Services role installed, with the Remote Desktop Licensing role service (Server Manager → Add Roles and Features).
rds-b1-pas2: 2. Open Server Manager → Tools → Remote Desktop Services → Remote Desktop Licensing Manager.
rds-b1-pas3: 3. If the license server shows as not activated, right-click its name → Activate Server and follow the wizard, using the Automatic connection method.
rds-b1-pas5: 5. Under “License program” choose Retail purchase and click Next.
rds-b1-pas6: 6. Enter the license code you received (25 characters), click Add, then Next and Finish. The licenses appear in the list with the number of users or devices.
rds-b2-pas1: 1. Open Server Manager → Remote Desktop Services → Overview → Tasks → Edit Deployment Properties → RD Licensing.
rds-b2-pas2: 2. Choose the mode that matches your licenses: Per User for user CALs or Per Device for device CALs. Add the license server and click OK.
rds-b2-pas2-nota: Without an RDS deployment, the same settings are made in Group Policy: Computer Configuration → Administrative Templates → Windows Components → Remote Desktop Services → Remote Desktop Session Host → Licensing.
rds-b2-pas3: 3. Check the configuration in Tools → Remote Desktop Services → RD Licensing Diagnoser. If no warnings appear, the licenses are active.
offcont-info1: This guide applies to licenses that are linked to a Microsoft account: Office Home & Business 2019 / 2021 / 2024, Office Pro Plus, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Project and Visio on a Microsoft account. The installer is downloaded directly from your account after the key is linked.
offcont-erori1-1: Linking the key is permanent: the license stays tied to the Microsoft account you use. Use your own personal or company account, not a temporary one.
offcont-erori1-2: Uninstall older Office versions and trial versions (preinstalled Microsoft 365) from Settings → Apps.
offcont-sectiune1: Linking the key to your account
offcont-b1-pas1: 1. Go to setup.office.com and click Sign in.
offcont-b1-pas2: 2. Sign in with your Microsoft account (Outlook, Hotmail, Live or company address). If you don’t have one, click Create one – it’s free.
offcont-b1-pas3: 3. Enter the 25-character product key, choose your country and language, then click Next.
offcont-b1-pas4: 4. Confirm. The product now appears in your account at account.microsoft.com/services.
offcont-b2-pas1: 1. On the Services & subscriptions page, next to your product, click Install (choose the language and the 64-bit version if needed).
offcont-b2-pas2: 2. Run the downloaded file (Setup…exe) and click Yes if Windows asks for permission. Wait for the installation to finish.
offcont-b2-pas3: 3. Open Word (or the installed app) and, when prompted, sign in with the same Microsoft account.
offcont-b2-pas4: 4. Accept the license terms. Office activates automatically and is ready to use.
offcont-b2-pas4-nota: To reinstall (for example after reformatting the computer) you no longer need the key: sign in to the same account and click Install again. Office Home & Business 2021 and 2024 can also be installed on a Mac from the same page.
off1013-info1: This guide applies to Office Professional Plus, Project and Visio, versions 2010 and 2013.
off1013-b1-pas1: 1. Double-click the installation kit (.iso / .img file) to open it, then run setup.exe.
off1013-b1-pas2: 2. If setup asks for the key, enter it and click Continue. Accept the license terms.
off1013-b1-pas3: 3. Click Install Now and wait for the installation to finish.
off1013-b2-pas1: 1. Open Word (or Project / Visio). In Office 2013 go to File → Account; in Office 2010, go to File → Help.
off1013-b2-pas2: 2. Click Change Product Key, enter the key you received and click Install / Continue.
off1013-b2-pas3: 3. In the activation wizard choose I want to activate the software over the Internet. When the confirmation appears, Office is activated.
off1013-b3-pas1: 1. In the activation wizard choose I want to activate the software by telephone and select your country. The Installation ID appears on the screen.
off1013-b3-pas2: 2. Open the site below and enter the Installation ID shown in the activation wizard.
off1013-b3-pas3: 3. Click Get confirmation ID to obtain the Confirmation ID.
off1013-b3-pas4: 4. Enter the Confirmation ID in the fields at the bottom of the wizard and click Next. Office is activated.
offapp-info1: This guide applies to Project, Visio, Outlook and Access, versions 2016 – 2024, activated with a product key. Download the kit that matches your key’s product and version:
offapp-erori1-1: If another Office version is installed, setup may stop with a compatibility error. In that case, uninstall the old version from Settings → Apps and run setup again.
offapp-erori1-2: For licenses on a Microsoft account, use the Office on a Microsoft account guide.
offapp-b1-pas1: 1. Double-click the downloaded file (.img) to open it, then run Setup.
offapp-b1-pas2: 2. Wait for the installation to finish, then click Close.
offapp-b1-pas3: 3. Open the installed app (Project, Visio, Outlook or Access). When the activation screen appears, choose I don’t want to sign in or create an account / Enter product key.
offapp-b1-pas4: 4. Enter the key you received and click Activate. The app is activated.
offapp-b2-pas1: 1. If online activation fails, choose I want to activate the software by telephone in the activation wizard and select your country.
offapp-b2-pas2: 2. Open the site below and enter the Installation ID shown in the activation wizard.
offapp-b2-pas3: 3. Click Get confirmation ID to obtain the Confirmation ID.
offapp-b2-pas4: 4. Enter the Confirmation ID in the wizard and click Next. The app is activated.
adsk-info1: This guide applies to Autodesk subscription licenses linked to an account (Fusion, AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor, 3ds Max, Autodesk collections, etc.). The license is tied to the email address provided with the order; there is no key to enter.
adsk-b1-pas1: 1. You will receive an email from Autodesk telling you the product has been assigned to you. Click the button in the email or go directly to manage.autodesk.com.
adsk-b1-pas2: 2. Sign in with the same email address the product was assigned to. If you don’t have an Autodesk account yet, create one for free with this address.
adsk-b1-pas3: 3. Go to Products and Services → All Products. The product should appear in the list.
adsk-b2-pas1: 1. Next to the product, click View Downloads / Download, choose the version, operating system and language, then download the installer.
adsk-b2-pas2: 2. Run the installer, accept the license terms and click Install. Wait for the installation to finish.
adsk-b2-pas3: 3. Open the program and, on the sign-in screen, sign in with the same Autodesk account.
adsk-b2-pas4: 4. The license is checked automatically when you sign in, and the program is ready to use.
adsk-b2-pas4-nota: If a message says you don’t have access to the product, sign out of the program (account name menu → Sign out) and sign in again with the exact address the product was assigned to.
srv-info2: The kits above are Microsoft’s official evaluation versions. During setup choose the edition of your key (Standard or Datacenter, with Desktop Experience), then convert it with the key as shown in the “Converting from the evaluation version” section.
srv-b2-pas2-nota: The Datacenter evaluation can only be converted to Datacenter; the Standard evaluation can be converted to Standard or Datacenter.
